message:
Patch CodedInputStream in protobuf fork to fix CVE

This is an application of the following commits:
1) https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/commit/562fc946c748d0ddb451ad1ce48570685f23a4f1
2) https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/commit/4728531c162f2f9e8c2ca1add713cfee2db6be3b

The version has been changed to 2.6.1-2. After it's deployed, the
dependency will be updated in the project, and there will be a test
checking that deeply nested group proto messages lead to
InvalidProtocolBufferException (instead of StackOverflowError).

 #KT-80597
